# Old translation system for modules is causing error 500 (isUsingNewTranslationSystem = false)

When you try to translate module with isUsingNewTranslationSystem = false you got error 500. Check screenshot.
![Untitled](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/35b83781-8933-41e8-aed2-8915d5af4f35)

## Attendu
It should work like expected (there should be compatiblity with old translation system - check source base, there is compatibility - `./classes/module/Module.php + ./controllers/admin/AdminTranslationsController.php + ./controllers/admin/AdminModulesController.php` ).

Or at least there should be "friendly" message, not 500. I prepare test module for this testing purpose.

## Étapes
0. enable debug mod
1. go to section modules
2. upload this module ([shaim_test_translation.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17367077/shaim_test_translation.zip))
3. go to module configuraiton
4. click on translate 
5. you will see 500 error
